description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing Git stash functionality, particularly with the '-p' (patch) option. It contains setup routines, test cases with assertions, and usage scenarios for the 'git stash save -p' command, involving various states of the repository and interactions with files, commits, and stash application.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the state for a specific file in the working directory and index.

methods.description: Writes a sequence of lines to standard input for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that the following Git command fails as expected.
